text.prefix: Policy attachments [p.6] in WSDL 1.1 can be used to associate policies [p.6] with four different types of policy subject [p.7] , identified as the service policy subject, the endpoint policy subject, the operation policy subject, and the message policy subject. These subjects should be considered as nested, due to the hierarchical nature of WSDL.
